## Problem and resulting behavior / Проблема и результат

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user. Link the related issue if any.

## Validation / Проверки

List checks actually performed and their results. State what was not tested and why. For UI changes, include screenshots with synthetic data and all secrets removed.

## Data, compatibility and security / Данные, совместимость, безопасность

Describe migrations, rollback, configuration or access-rule changes, or state that there are none. Report vulnerabilities privately under SECURITY.md instead of disclosing them in this PR.

## Documentation / Документация

List English/Russian documentation updated for behavior changes, or explain why none is needed.
